name: 11213 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11213 (Brooklyn) has 450 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11213 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11213 (Brooklyn) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
